node.label: combined oxidative phosphorylation defect type 8
node.definition: Combined oxidative phosphorylation defect type 8 is a mitochondrial disease due to a defect in mitochondrial protein synthesis resulting in deficiency of respiratory chain complexes I, III and IV in the cardiac and skeletal muscle and brain characterized by severe hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, pulmonary hypoplasia, generalized muscle weakness and neurological involvement.
synonyms: combined oxidative phosphorylation deficiency caused by mutation in AARS2

evidence.snippet: Disease-causing germline mutation(s) in (Assessed) — alanyl-tRNA synthetase 2, mitochondrial
AARS2 is annotated as disease gene of OMIM:614096 (HPO genes_to_phenotype, OMIM-derived)
